programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts. They revive the memory of the festival, the music and the experience.

programme.title: Myung-whun Chung And Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino - Mahler - Symphony No. 9
programme.desc: Maestro Myung-Whun Chung leads the Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in this touching performance of Gustav Mahler’s Symphony No. 9 in D major. Written in 1908-1909, it was the last symphony Mahler completed. Initially, the superstitious composer, believing in the so-called ‘curse of the ninth,’ did not want to write a Symphony No. 9.

programme.title: China Moses, Joe Armon Jones And Luke Wynter - China Moses: 'Whatever' at Jazz à Ramatuelle
programme.desc: In 1988, Dee Dee Bridgewater was one of the first great jazz singers to perform at the Jazz Festival in Ramatuelle. In 2016, the story seems to repeat itself as her daughter China Moses took the stage at Ramatuelle. Over the years, China Moses has become a mature performer with a unique style: rocky voice, sharp sense of swing, and intense/energetic stage presence. After signing compilations dedicated to Dinah Washington and blues, Moses released in 2016 an album of his own compositions, entitled Whatever. Get ready for a most entertaining performance combining jazz, soul, and hip-hop.

programme.title: Anne Chris - Anne Chris: Just Kissed The Sun
programme.desc: What happens when two musicians are trapped on a cruise ship for a week? Naturally, a new album sees the light of day - at least that’s what happened when Anne Chris and pianist Daan Herweg found themselves on a journey by ship together. After a week of providing their fellow passengers with musical entertainment, the two headed to the studio and within a year, Anne Chris’s new album Just Kissed the Sun saw its release. The Dutch singer presents her third album at the North Sea Jazz Club, accompanied by guest artist Bas van der Wal on guitar. Next to the sun, the sound of Robert Glasper, Gretchen Parlato, John Mayer, Esperanza Spalding, Jill Scott and Michael Jackson also seem to have inspired this joyful record.

programme.title: Harmen Fraanje, Malik Mezzadri, Brice Soniano And Thoma Gouband - Paradox Live: Harmen Fraanje
programme.desc: Innovative contemporary jazz and improvised music, the search for modernity, mind blowing sounds, rock and pop… Indeed PARADOX Tilburg goes beyond jazz, crossing musical boundaries into the unknown soundscapes of electronic music. Indie artists, blues veterans and jazz superstars all pour their hearts and souls at the Paradox. From young, local talents to top national and international artists, PARADOX Tilburg is the most intimate jazz club in the Netherlands, with a devoted audience from all across Europe. In their TV show PARADOX LIVE you get a taste of the greatest concerts and interviews with artists from all around the world. This episode of PARADOX LIVE presents the amazing Dutch pianist and composer Harmen Fraanje.

programme.title: Quatuor Ebène - Beethoven - String Quartets No. 4, 5 And 12
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer’s sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven’s 650 pages of sheet music. Their efforts culminated in the performance of the composer’s complete repertoire for string quartet, which covers three decades of Beethoven's musical creativity, during six impressive concerts at Philharmonie de Paris in the autumn of 2020. Quatuor Ébène explored every facet of Beethoven's string quartet repertoire: from the youthful Opus 18 string quartets to the Razumovsky, Harp, and Serioso quartets (Opus 59, 74, and 95) from his middle period, and finally, the depth of his late quartets (Opus 127 to 135). This program features Quatuor Ébène performing Beethoven’s String Quartet No. 5 in A major, Op. 18, No. 5; String Quartet No. 4 in C minor, Op. 18, No. 4; and String Quartet No. 12 in E-flat major, Op. 127. This concert was recorded at Philharmonie de Paris on December 17, 2020.

programme.title: Christine Kamau - jazzahead! 2024 - Christine Kamau (KE)
programme.desc: Annual trade fair, exhibition, and festival jazzahead! is one of the international jazz community’s most important events. Hosted in Bremen, Germany, jazzahead! brings together musicians, bookers, agents, organizers, jazz experts, and music enthusiasts at the world’s largest jazz event. In 2024, jazzahead! paid special attention to the jazz scene of the Netherlands and invited over forty jazz acts to perform over the course of three days. Among the ensembles presenting themselves at jazzahead! 2024 is trumpeter Christine Kamau’s quartet. Kamau, hailing from Nakuru, Kenya, skillfully blends African rhythms with jazz fusion. She cites Hugh Masekela as her favorite trumpeter, with Roy Hargrove and Miles Davis also serving as significant influences. Using music as a means to promote unity, Kamau has appeared at jazz festivals across Africa, and has been involved in projects with organizations like Pro Helvetia, the British Council, and UNESCO. At jazzahead!, Christine Kamau (trumpet, vocals, synthesizer, keys) appears with Victor Kimetto (keys), Isaac Kimetto (bass), and Richard Wandati (drums).

programme.title: Samba das Flores - Samba das Flores - Da Pá Virada Sessions
programme.desc: The Da Pá Virada Sessions series presents the best musicians of contemporary Brazilian jazz, and beyond. Filmed in São Paulo, each session offers a unique experience by giving a fresh look into Brazil's music scene. The artists for each session are selected in consultation with Stingray DJAZZ's music editor. One of the bands taking part in this series is the ensemble Samba das Flores, which dedicates itself to exploring the world's different rhythms, thus keeping the Brazilian heritage alive. The individual voices of the ensemble members color Samba das Flores's unique sound. Let Brazilian culture and global rhythms inspire you during this Samba das Flores performance!

programme.title: Kenny Baron, Benny Green, Mulgrew Miller And Eric Reed - Four Pianists - Jazz a Vienne
programme.desc: ‘Jazz a Vienne’ is one of the world's most prestigious jazz festivals. Ever since 1981 it has attracted leading jazz artists, with many of them playing return engagements. Unsurprisingly, the festival's 2012 edition did not fall short of expectations: the lineup was filled with the biggest names in music. Among them were four legendary pianists united by the shared sense of making art: Mulgrew Miller, Benny Green, Kenny Barron, Eric Reed. Flawless piano technique, amazing musicianship and swing - the performance for true jazz lovers.

programme.title: The Clarinet Factory, Vojtěch Nýdl, Luděk Boura And Jindřich Pavliš - Classical:NEXT 2019 - Clarinet Factory
programme.desc: Considered to be one of the most unique ensembles to feature on the Czech scene in the last 25 years, the style of the Clarinet Factory hovers between contemporary and classical music, jazz and world music. As winners of the Classic Prague Awards in 2017 for 'Best Crossover Project', the quartet combines their classic music training and clarinet art with jazz, minimalism and improvisation to create their very own music without borders, capable of communicating directly with all audiences. The Clarinet Factory also experiment with electronics, both ambient and dance-oriented, and the four musicians remain ever fascinated with the possibilities of their instrument, considering their work as a music laboratory. Regularly collaborating with symphonic ensembles, vocalists, performance artists, the quartet have written music for film, theatre, ballet and contemporary dance. In this performance from 2019's Classical:NEXT!, the ensemble interprets their own works: Bird Song, Husa divoká, B-A-C-H, Hikari, Luda's Dance and L'Amour. The Clarinet Factory is made up of Vojtěch Nýdl (clarinet and vocals), Luděk Boura (clarinet), Jindřich Pavliš (clarinet), and Petr Valášek (bass clarinet).

programme.title: Pierre Boulez - Discovering Masterpieces - Concerto for Orchestra
programme.desc: Bela Bartok’s ‘Concerto for Orchestra’ is discussed. This piece is one of the most frequently performed works of the twentieth century. Pierre Boulez explains how he interpreted this composition with the Berlin Philharmonic.

programme.title: Joana Queiroz, Maria Beraldo Bastos, Mariá Portugal And Chicão - Quartabe - Da Pá Virada Sessions
programme.desc: The series Da Pá Virada sessions presents the best musicians of contemporary Brazilian jazz, and beyond. Filmed in São Paulo, each session offers a unique experience by giving a fresh look into Brazil's music scene. The artists for each session are selected in consultation with Stingray DJAZZ's music editor. One of the bands taking part in this series is Quartabê, a unique Brazilian quartet that has influences ranging as widely as the São Paulo avant-garde movement, free improvisation, pop, and electronic music, which all get their due share in the band's exhilarating live performances. Joana Queiroz (tenor sax and clarinets), Maria Beraldo Bastos (clarinets), Mariá Portugal (drums), and Chicão (keys) compose, arrange, improvise, and sing music that's wholly their own.

programme.title: Christian McBride - Marcus Strickland - The Middle Man
programme.desc: On July 20, 2018, double bassist Christian McBride presented his band ‘New Jawn’ at the Malta Jazz Festival. A five-time Grammy winner, McBride is one of the most requested, most recorded, and most respected figures in the music world today. Hailing from Philadelphia, this music luminary combines jazz, RAndB, pop/rock, hip hop/neo-soul, and classical. Gracing the Malta Jazz stage with him are Nasheet Waits (drums), Marcus Strickland (tenor sax), and Josh Evans (trumpet).

programme.title: Martina Rodriguez - DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Martha Argerich - Schumann - Piano Quintet in E-flat major, Op. 44
programme.desc: On the occasion of her 80th birthday, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich explored chamber music repertoire in this wonderful concert, recorded at Château de Chantilly, France. As part of this concert, the ‘Grande Dame’ of the piano is joined by violinists Maxim Vengerov and Tedi Papavrami, cellist Mischa Maisky, and her daughter Lyda Chen-Argerich on viola in a performance of Robert Schumann’s Piano Quintet in E-flat major, Op. 44. This performance was recorded on June 11, 2021.

programme.title: Grigory Sokolov - Live in Aix-en-Provence
programme.desc: The shy and elusive Grigroy Sokolov is one of the greatest pianists of our time. His performances leave critics and audiences alike speechless, like they don't quite believe what they have just experienced. In 2015, he played a beautiful recital with works by Johann Sebastian Bach, Ludwig van Beethoven, Franz Schubert, Frédéric Chopin, and Claude Debussy that took place at the Festival La Roque D'Anthéron in Aix-en-Provence. And just as he was wont to do, Sokolov delivered an unforgettable, magical musical moment. On the program: Bach – Partita for keyboard No. 1, BWV 825, Beethoven – Piano Sonata No. 7 in D major, Schubert – Sonata in a minor op. 143, Schubert – Six Moments Musicaux. The encores are Chopin – Mazurka in A minor, Chopin – Prelude No. 15 and Debussy – Prelude Canope.

programme.title: Kathleen Tagg And Andre Petersen - Classical:NEXT 2019 - Tagg And Petersen
programme.desc: The Kathleen Tagg / Andre Petersen piano duo brings together two of South Africa's most celebrated pianists: one eclectic-experimental classical and one jazz artist, in a unique and highly personal collaboration. Drawing inspiration from the rich sonic tapestries of classical music, nuances of South African jazz and traditional musics from sub-Saharan Africa, this duo explodes the concept of what two pianos can sound like: a bass guitar, goema drum, marimba and uhadi–plus mixing fully composed scores with improvisation in a bold, vital and highly entertaining mix with performances of original compositions and works by iconic South African jazz composers such as Abdullah Ibrahim, Bheki Mseleku and Moses Molelekwa. Tagg and Petersen explore diverse realms of possibilities within the sound world of the piano, their musical offerings paying tribute to the poignant legacy of people who have inspired their world-view and music making. In this performance from the 2019 edition of Classical:NEXT!, the talented pianists perform Bheki Mseleku, Angola, African Dawn / Cape Doctor, Second Time Around, Rapela, Time Watchers and Berimbau.

programme.title: Modern Jazz Quartet - Modern Jazz Quartet - Live Concert
programme.desc: Formed in 1952 from the rhythm section of Dizzy Gillespie's big band, the Modern Jazz Quartet took its inspiration from classical chamber music as well as jazz's blues roots. The group enjoyed a decades-long career with multiple critically acclaimed albums, cementing their place in the history of the genre. Following concerts in Rotterdam and Amsterdam the days before, the Modern Jazz Quartet performed at Singer Concertzaal in Laren for Dutch TV on March 31, 1969. Composed of Milt Jackson on vibraphone, John Lewis on piano, Percy Heath on bass, and Connie Kay on drums, the foursome plays with elegance and style.

programme.title: Raul Midón - 4K Clips
programme.desc: Stunning 4K clips from the world of pop, rock, jazz, classical music, dance, and theater

programme.title: Karin Fernandes - Karin Fernandes - Da Pá Virada Sessions
programme.desc: The Da Pá Virada Sessions series presents the best musicians of contemporary Brazilian jazz, and beyond. Filmed in São Paulo, each session offers a unique experience by giving a fresh look into Brazil's music scene. The artists for each session are selected in consultation with Stingray DJAZZ's music editor. One of the artists taking part in this series is pianist Karin Fernandes. She is dedicated to the performance of 20th and 21st century piano repertoire and has premiered numerous new compositions. As a soloist, Karin Fernandes has performed with prestigious Brazilian orchestras.

programme.title: Orlando Julius - BIRDtv: Orlando Julius
programme.desc: Rotterdam’s ‘ BIRD’ is a club, café and restaurant with a live music programme that's deeply rooted in jazz, and also branches out towards soul, funk, hip-hop and electronic music as well. Its name ‘BIRD’ refers to the nickname of the legendary New York jazz saxophonist, bebop co-founder Charlie Parker (1920-1955). BIRD serves Neapolitan pizzas, good wines, no-nonsense beers and an all-round metropolitan rawness. Since 2014, this urban jazz club and DJAZZ.tv have been collaborating for a series of music programmes: ‘BIRD.tv’, allowing you to experience the best BIRD concerts and interviews as from a first row seat! In this episode, our guest is an old-timer from African music: the saxophonist and composer Orlando Julius (*1943). Doubtlessly, he is royalty among Nigerian musicians. In his music, Julius combines highlife, jazz, soul, and RAndB in ground-breaking ways.

programme.title: Ray Charles And The Raelettes - Ray Charles and the Raelettes - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1980, American soul legend Ray Charles brought the Raelettes and the Ray Charles Orchestra to the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague. With the full force of these two groups behind him, Charles showed why throughout his storied career he has been viewed as one of the most recognizable voices in music.

programme.title: Antonio Faraò - Jazz à Ramatuelle: Antonio Faraò
programme.desc: In 1998, Antonio Faraò won the prestigious Concours Martial Solal, awarded to him by Herbie Hancock! Since then, this talented Italian jazz pianist has made his mark as a player of elegance and lyricism, which has allowed him to collaborate with the best European and American musicians. On his last album Evan, recorded in the United States, he leads an all-star band starring Joe Lovano on tenor saxophone. On a beautiful summer night at the French Jazz à Ramatuelle festival, Faraò performs at the breathtaking Theatre de Verdure in the company of saxophone legend Dave Liebman. With refined ballads, a feline groove, elegance, and lyricism, this musical meeting sparkles – if you watch closely you might even see some bright new stars lighting up in the night sky above Ramatuelle!

programme.title: Sir Simon Rattle - Mendelssohn - Violin Concerto, Op. 64
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle conducts the Berlin Philharmonic in the 2016 edition of the Europakonzert. This time, it takes place at the beautiful Baroque church of Røros, a Norwegian mining town whose intact picturesque old town makes it a UNESCO World Heritage Site. The talented Norwegian violinist Vilde Frang is the star soloist in Mendelssohn’s songful Violin Concerto, Op. 64, which she plays with warmth, elegance and effortless virtuosity.

programme.title: Emmanuelle Leblanc, Pastelle LeBlanc And Pascal Miousse - Vishten - WOMEX 2018
programme.desc: Since 1994, World Music Expo (WOMEX) has been attracting musicians, agents, a great number of press agencies, as well as media companies from all over the world. Its main exposition event has been held in various locations throughout Europe, including Berlin, Brussels, Marseille, Stockholm, Seville, Cardiff, and Budapest. The 2018 edition of WOMEX was held in Las Palmas, Gran Canaria. One of its showcase participants, Vishten, has been animating audiences for 15 years with its fiery blend of traditional French songs and original instrumentals fusing Celtic, Acadian and contemporary folk influences with energetic virtuosity. The trio comprises multi-instrumentalists Emmanuelle and Pastelle LeBlanc from Prince Edward Island and Pascal Miousse from the Magdalen Islands.

programme.title: Ballets de Monte Carlo - Sheherazade
programme.desc: More than just a tribute to the Ballets Russes, this version of Sheherazade by Jean-Christophe Maillot, resonates as the reunion between choreography and the fictive or real beings which have nourished his artistic universe over his thirty year career. Amongst the characters inhabiting his memory, the beautiful Sheherazade will have often danced before the choreographer's eyes, but the real tête-à-tête with the princess from the Thousand and One Nights has been postponed for a long time. This performance is recorded at the Opéra de Monte-Carlo in 2010. Solists of the Ballets de Monte-Carlo are Bernice Coppieters, Gaëtan Morlotti, Leart Duraku, Olivier Lucea, Alexis Oliveira, Georges Oliveira.

programme.title: Green Velvet, MK, Carl Cox And deadmau5 - Creamfields
programme.desc: Having burst onto the ever-growing festival scene two decades ago, Creamfields has secured its spot as being one of the - if not the - biggest weekend dedicated to electronic music in the UK. Currently, the clubbing and raving pilgrimage attracts an impressive 70,000 festival-goers over the weekend. Continuously offering up the very best in EDM, house, trance, drum and bass, grime, and more, Creamfields has hosted some massive names over the past twenty years. This 2019 edition of Creamfields presents Green Velvet, MK, Carl Cox, Deadmau5, Camelphat, Nicole Moudaber, Dimitri Vegas And Like Mike, and many more!

programme.title: Ensemble Made in Canada, Elissa Lee, Sharon Wei And Rachel Mercer - Mosaïque Project - Canadian Piano Quartets
programme.desc: This very special concert event celebrates the diversity and richness of Canada through the eyes and ears of its people. Ensemble Made in Canada’s Mosaique Project features a commissioned suite of piano quartets by 14 Canadian composers, each inspired by a region of our vast country. Their album release and two-year National tour culminate in St. Catharines’ stunning Partridge Hall! The ensemble consists of Elissa Lee (violin) Sharon Wei (viola), Rachel Mercer (cello) and Angela Park (piano) and is rapidly gaining recognition as Canada’s premier piano quartet.

programme.title: The Ensemble HOPE - Classical:NEXT 2019 - Ensemble HOPE
programme.desc: The Ensemble HOPE is dedicated to the performance and creation of music of today. As well as exploring new forms of contemporary electro-acoustic technology, it integrates written musical tradition, improvisation and an adapted classical repertoire. The Cristal Baschet and the Euphone form the basis of the ensemble's sophisticated instrumental collection. The new works reflect these neglected and little-known instruments. The Ensemble HOPE, consisting of Frederic Bousquet (Euphone), Marc Antoine Millon (Bass Cristal) and Armelle Marq (soprano voice), is also actively engaged in developing a new generation of Euphones. In this concert from 2019's Classical:NEXT!, the ensemble performs Frederic Bousquet's Vénus, Epilogue and en transit, Henry Purcell's Dido’s lament, arranged by M.A. Millon, Georg Friedrich Händel's Lascia ch'io pianga, arranged by M.A. Millon, as well as works by Eric Satie, Roger Steptoe, Bruno Giner, and Marc Antoine Millon.

programme.title: Carlos Miguel Prieto And Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería - Mahler - Symphony No. 6
programme.desc: Mahler's Symphony No. 6 is a monumental work exploring deep personal tragedy, incorporating a unique, famous hammer blows that symbolize the inevitable blows of fate. This symphony's intense emotional power, epic scope, and the composer's eventual wrestling with fate and personal loss make it an unforgettable, profoundly moving experience for audiences.

programme.title: Dizzy Gillespie - DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Martina Marana - Martina - Da Pá Virada Sessions
programme.desc: The Da Pá Virada Sessions series presents the best musicians of contemporary Brazilian jazz, and beyond. Filmed in São Paulo, each session offers a unique experience by giving a fresh look into Brazil's music scene. The artists for each session are selected in consultation with Stingray DJAZZ's music editor. One of the artists taking part in this series is Martina Marana. Vocalist, instrumentalist, and composer Martina Marana uses the power of irony to show how women instrumentalists are misjudged. In her music, Martina breaks free of sexist labels, reclaiming her own power as musician and composer. A gifted lyricist, Marana makes uncompromising, unique music.

programme.title: Kent Nagano, Israel Philharmonic Orchestra And Daniil Trifonov - Liszt - Piano Concerto No. 1 in E-flat, S.124
programme.desc: Dazzling, virtuosic, and spectacular: no other adjectives are better suited to describe the piano music of Franz Liszt. Enjoy a sparkling performance of Liszt’s Piano Concerto No. 1 in E flat major by the incredible piano virtuoso Russian Daniil Trifonov, with Kent Nagano conducting the Israel Philharmonic Orchestra. As an encore, Trifonov performs Reflets dans l'eau from Debussy's Images. The orchestra closes this concert with a rendition of Mahler's Symphony No. 7. Recorded at the Charles Bronfman Auditorium, Tel Aviv, in 2014.

programme.title: Ray Charles - What'd I Say
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1980, American soul legend Ray Charles brought the Raelettes and the Ray Charles Orchestra to the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague. With the full force of these two groups behind him, Charles showed why throughout his storied career he has been viewed as one of the most recognizable voices in music.

programme.title: Earl Hines - Earl Hines Quartet in Spa, 1977
programme.desc: Despite his advanced age, the legendary jazz pianist Earl Hines was at the top of his game when he performed in the Belgian town of Spa in 1977. With a band consisting of Rudy Rutherford (reeds), Jimmy Leary (bass), and Eddie Graham (drums), Hines livens up the room with his interpretations of “I Can’t Believe That You’re In Love With Me” and “The Man I Love.” Marva Josie joins the group for soulful renditions of “A Sunday Kind of Love” and the well-known classic “Kansas City” before the set comes to a close with “Caravan,” which features a lengthy drum solo by Graham.

programme.title: Nelida Karr And Elvis Bob - WOMEX 2018
programme.desc: Since 1994, World Music Expo (WOMEX) has been attracting musicians, agents, a great number of press agencies, as well as media companies from all over the world. Its main exposition event has been held in various locations throughout Europe, including Berlin, Brussels, Marseille, Stockholm, Seville, Cardiff, and Budapest. In 2018, WOMEX was held in Las Palmas, Gran Canaria. One of its showcase participants, Nelida Karr, sings and plays guitar, piano, cello and percussion. She writes songs suffused with the many influences she assimilated growing up in Malabo in Africa’s only Spanish-speaking country, Equatorial Guinea. The result is an eclectic mix that she nevertheless incorporates into a sound all her own.

programme.title: Mikhail Pletnev - Bizet - L'Arlésienne Suite
programme.desc: Mikhail Pletnev leads the Russian National Orchestra (RNO) in a performance of Maurice Ravel's Piano Concerto No. 1 with Lucas Debargue as the soloist. The concert opens with a selection of music by Georges Bizet based on Alphonse Daudet's play 'L'Arlésienne'. The music is compiled by Mikhail Pletnev. The first movement of Ravel's Piano Concerto No. 1 contains five distinctive themes, of which three are reminiscent of jazz. Debargue's performance of Ravel's concerto is followed by Gabriel Fauré's Barcarolle No. 4. The performance was recorded at Tchaikovsky Concert Hall in Moscow as part of the Ninth RNO Grand Festival.

programme.title: Soloists of the Lucerne Festival Orchestra - Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Avishai Cohen - 4K Clips
programme.desc: Stunning 4K clips from the world of pop, rock, jazz, classical music, dance, and theater

programme.title: Buddy Rich - DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Reinier Baas - jazzahead! 2024 interview - Baas And van Gelder
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. These portraits were recorded at jazzahead! 2024 in Bremen, Germany.

programme.title: Ana María Paño-Osorio And Philharmonie de Paris - Sinfonía por el Perú from Philharmonie de Paris
programme.desc: Superstar tenor Juan Diego Flórez brings to life the most iconic roles of the bel canto repertoire, joined by the vibrant young musicians of Sinfonía por el Perú, led by the celebrated conductor Ana María Patiño-Osorio! Embark on a lyrical adventure with them, from the powerful drama of Bellini's I Capuleti e I Montecchi and the majestic Jerusalem by Verdi, to the boisterous and spirited cancan of Offenbach's operetta Orpheus in the Underworld.Sinfonía por el Perú is a nonprofit organization founded by Juan Diego Flórez, with a mission to inspire social change through collective music education. Since its inception in 2011, over six thousand young Peruvians have embraced the opportunity to play an instrument or sing in a choir. Students from the program have graced the world's most prestigious stages, from Salzburg to Gstaad, including the Lucerne Festival, and they accompany Juan Diego Flórez for this concert.

programme.title: Kenny Barron - Alfa Jazz Festival Lviv, Ukraine
programme.desc: Pianist Kenny Barron’s June 27, 2019 appearance at the Alfa Jazz Festival in Ukraine’s Lviv was a celebration of sublime jazz virtuosity.

programme.title: Paulo Novaes - Brazilian NYE
programme.desc: Paulo Novaes - Brazilian NYE

programme.title: Krzysztof Penderecki, Prague Radio Symphony Orchestra, Slovak Philharmonic Choir And Iwona Hossa - Penderecki - Symphony No. 7: 7 Gates of Jerusalem
programme.desc: The 2017 Prague Spring festival is brought to a powerful close as Krzysztof Penderecki conducts the Prague Radio Symphony Orchestra and Slovak Philharmonic Choir in a performance of his monumental seventh symphony Seven Gates of Jerusalem. This work bears witness to an introspective thought about faith, written in honour of the city of Jerusalem, for soloists, choir and orchestra, with libretto taken from Old Testament. For expressive purposes, Penderecki uses specific instruments: the tubaphone, percussive objects designed by the composer himself, and the shofar, an ancient Jewish liturgical instrument. Soloists for this performance include Iwona Hossa (soprano), Karolina Sikora (soprano), Anna Lubanska (mezzo-soprano), Adam Zdunikowsk (tenor), Piotr Nowacki (bass) and David Švehlík (speaker). Also featured in the programme is a rendition of the Serenade for Orchestra by Czech composer Isa Krejci. Recorded at Smetana Hall in Prague, Czech Republic.

programme.title: Jazz à Vienne - DJAZZ Portrait: Jazz à Vienne
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts. They revive the memory of the festival, the music and the experience.

programme.title: Muse - Live at Festival Rock Am Ring
programme.desc: Rock Am Ring (Nürburgring), Rock Im Park (Nuremberg) is a music festival that takes place annually at the Nürburgring Race Track in western Germany. Featuring Muse.

programme.title: Kinan Azmeh, Rony Barrak, Jonas Burgwinkel And Michel Godard - The Morgenland Festival: Needless to Say
programme.desc: Since 2005, the Morgenland Festival of Osnabrueck has dedicated itself to the fascinating music culture of the Near and Middle East. From traditional and classical music to avant-garde, jazz, and rock, the festival program also features art, such as visual arts, dance, and theatre of interdisciplinary projects. Enjoy the musical wealth of the All Star Band in this episode of Morgenland Festival. Featuring graduate of the Boston Conservatory and vocalist Dima Oshno, both songs “Dream” and “Mugam” are played by the All Star Band and express a range of moods that vary from peaceful quietude to outbursts of energy.

programme.title: The Crusaders - Chain Reaction
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. The Crusaders, an American jazz fusion group that was popular in the '70s employed a two-manned front-line horn section. The group’s sound was rooted in hard bop, with an emphasis on RAndB and soul. Their performance at Estival is beyond soulful and an amazing show to watch.

programme.title: Sandro Schneebeli Quartet - DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: OPERA2DAY, Tetraktys Ensemble, Het Nationale Toneel And Hannah Hoekstra - Mariken in the Garden of Earthly Delights
programme.desc: The opera ‘Mariken in the Garden of Earthly Delights,’ to music by Calliope Tsoupaki, is based on the miracle play 'Mariken van Nieumeghen' (c. 1515). Over five centuries, this old story hasn’t lost a bit of its power and is unquestionably part of the canon of Dutch culture. In this opera, we follow the curious but vulnerable Mariken on a journey through a dark world. She encounters intriguing characters, such as a witchlike aunt, a seductive devil, and an inquisitorial pope. The ASKO|Schönberg and the Tetraktys Ensemble are under the musical direction of Hernán Schvartzman. Main soloists are Hannah Hoekstra (Mariken), Harry van der Kamp (Uncle), Jill Feldman (Aunt), Julian Podger (Moenen), and Michael Chance (Pope). Staged by Serge van Veggel, and directed by Sonia Herman Dolz. Recorded at the Royal Theater in The Hague, in 2015.

programme.title: Pete Doherty - Pete Doherty And Frederic Lo Live at Le Trianon
programme.desc: For his latest project, Peter Doherty (The Libertines, Babyshambles, Peter Doherty And The Puta Madres) has teamed up with Frédéric Lo, a guitarist and composer known for his work with Daniel Darc on the album Crèvecœur.

programme.title: Ibrahim Maalouf - DJAZZ Portrait: Ibrahim Maalouf
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts. They revive the memory of the festival, the music and the experience.

programme.title: Lav Sol - jazzahead! 2023
programme.desc: Annual trade fair, exhibition, and festival jazzahead! is one of the international jazz community's most important events. Hosted in Bremen, Germany, jazzahead! brings together musicians, bookers, agents, organizers, jazz experts, and music enthusiasts at the world’s largest jazz event. In 2023, jazzahead! paid special attention to Germany’s jazz scene and invited thirty jazz acts from all over the world to perform over the course of three days. Among the artists presenting themselves at jazzahead! 2023 is the Norwegian trio Lav Sol. Their name means ‘Low Sun’, a great inspiration for their improvised music fueled by electronica, hip-hop, and rock.

programme.title: Bálint Gyémánt - jazzahead! 2024 - Bálint Gyémánt (HU)
programme.desc: Among the ensembles presenting themselves at jazzahead! 2024 is the trio of Hungarian guitarist and composer Bálint Gyémánt. Gyémánt, widely recognized for his collaboration with vocalist Veronika Harcsa, is committed to artistic freedom, and the continual exploration of new sonic possibilities. His trio album ‘Vortex of Silence’ invites listeners to explore and reinterpret the harmony and disharmony of the world through its music.

programme.title: Richie Hawtin - Richie Hawtin at Family Piknik 2017
programme.desc: Born in Britain and raised in Canada, Richie Hawtin is one of the biggest names in today's electro minimal and is one of the instigators of electro house. Hawtin, who rightly calls himself an artist, is always looking for new concepts and ways to push technological boundaries. Let yourself be carried away by the unique and dancing techno rhythms of this innovative DJ with this highly creative set delivered as part of the 2017 edition of the Family Piknik festival.

programme.title: Claudio Abbado, Berliner Philharmoniker, Mirella Freni And Christine Schäfer - Gala from Berlin 1998 - Songs of Love and Desire
programme.desc: Featuring W. A. Mozart and Giuseppe Verdi, love is the theme of this 1998 New Year's Eve concert. Maestro Claudio Abbado selected two of the best Mozart interpreters, Christine Schäfer and Simon Keenlyside, for this traditionally meaningful event. Marcelo Álvarez from Argentina, who some compare to a young Domingo, sings highlights of the tenor repertoire, and Italian prima donna Mirella Freni tops the occasion with a breath-taking performance of the letter scene from Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky's Eugen Onegin.

programme.title: Public Enemy - Public Enemy - Live at The Metro Theatre
programme.desc: Public Enemy, also known as PE, is an influential hip hop group from Long Island, New York, known for its politically charged lyrics, criticism of the media, and active interest in the concerns of the African American community. In 2004, Rolling Stone Magazine ranked Public Enemy number forty-four on its list of the Immortals: 100. Here, the group performs at The Metro Theatre, in Sydney, Australia, on December 27, 2008.

programme.title: Christian McBride - 4K Clips
programme.desc: Stunning 4K clips from the world of pop, rock, jazz, classical music, dance, and theater

programme.title: Christine and the Queens - Live aux Vieilles Charrues
programme.desc: French singer Héloïse Létissier, aka Christine and the Queens, originates from Nantes, France. Her debut album Chaleur Humaine earned her a Victories of Music award in 2015, paving the way for future success. A versatile artist skilled in music and dance, she surrounds herself with the best. Among others, she collaborated with dancer and choreographer Marion Motin, who accompanied Madonna. In 2018, Christine and the Queens shortened her name to Chris and hit the international scene with a self-titled album. Her artistic work opens up a new perspective on femininity and masculinity, a hot topic today. In this concert, she inspires her audience at Les Vieilles Charrues in Carhaix, France, to dance all night long.

programme.title: Zubin Mehta And Israel Philharmonic Orchestra - In Rehearsal: Zubin Mehta
programme.desc: Indian conductor Zubin Mehta (1936) became Music Director of the Israel Philharmonic Orchestra (IPO) in 1977 and was appointed Music Director for Life in 1981. On July 18, 1996, Mehta led the IPO in its first-ever performance of Richard Strauss’s tone poem Till Eulenspiegels lustige Streiche, Op. 28. This episode of ‘In Rehearsal’ offers an intimate look at the dialogue between Mehta and the musicians as they explore Strauss’s tone poem together.

programme.title: Errol Garner - Erroll Garner - Live in Singer Concertzaal, Laren
programme.desc: On June 18, 1962, American pianist and composer Erroll Garner performed at the Singer Concertzaal in Laren. The vibrant and joyous concert was played with drummer Kelly Martin and bassist Eddie Calhoun, each long-standing collaborators from Garner's trio. The Singer Concertzaal in Laren, the Netherlands is a concert hall and museum dedicated to the preservation of the art collection of American William Henry Singer. It features a variety of artists, both visual and aural.

programme.title: Pete Doherty - Pete Doherty And Frederic Lo Live at Le Trianon
programme.desc: For his latest project, Peter Doherty (The Libertines, Babyshambles, Peter Doherty And The Puta Madres) has teamed up with Frédéric Lo, a guitarist and composer known for his work with Daniel Darc on the album Crèvecœur.

programme.title: Thomas Carbou And Jeff Moran - Jeff Moran And Thomas Carbou live à Quebec
programme.desc: Thomas Carbou and Jeff Moran share an almost telepathic rapport, blending spontaneous improvisation, electronic looping, and Brazilian and Indian musical influences to create ecstatic groove pieces and dream-like soundscapes. They use a wide array of instruments, including a custom-built 8-string guitar, cuatro, bouzouki, cajón, frame drums, berimbau, udu, and metal percussion instruments, as well as samplers and laptops, adding their own hypnotic vocals to the mix.

programme.title: Herbert Blomstedt - Beethoven - Symphony No. 2, Op. 36
programme.desc: In this concert at the Lucerne Festival, Swedish conductor Herbert Blomstedt leads the Lucerne Festival Orchestra in a performance of Ludwig van Beethoven's Symphony No. 2 in D major, Op. 36. This performance was recorded at the Lucerne Culture and Congress Center (KKL), Switzerland, in August 2020.

D'abord simples panneaux de bois, puis installations sonores, ils deviendront lumineux au 20ème siècle et Maestro nous expliquera le choix de leurs trois couleurs : rouge, orange, vert.

programme.title: COMPOSTMAN ET MOI

Ils décident de la suivre au parc et découvre un jeune corbeau blessé qu'elle a soigné et nommé Marcello ! Ils ne cachent pas leur enthousiasme en voyant la complicité que Bintou a construit avec ce nouvel ami. Mais l'attachement de cette dernière pour l'animal sauvage s'est intesifié à tel point qu'elle n'arrive pas à le laisser partir.

programme.title: COMPOSTMAN ET MOI
programme.desc: C'est bientôt l'anniversaire de Léon. Charlie en parle avec enthousiasme, mais Compostman ne sait pas ce qu'est un anniversaire. Charlie se rend compte que Compostman n'a pas de date pour célébrer sa naissance, il n'a pas d'âge non plus d'ailleurs... charlie ets bien décidée à trouver quelle est la date d'anniversaire de son ami et lui célébrer!

programme.title: INTÉRIEURS

Dans cette petite Toscane, ils éprouvent un coup de cœur pour une imposante bâtisse du XVIIIème, laissée à l'abandon depuis près de 30 ans.

Condamné à effectuer un Travail d’Intérêt Général dans un commissariat, Rayan y retrouve avec effroi sa victime dont il devient le chauffeur. Ce duo improbable va peu à peu apprendre à se connaître et à rapprocher la loi et la rue.

Audrey s’entend immédiatement avec Quentin, qui a lui aussi beaucoup d’intuition avec les animaux. Mais Tommy voit d’un mauvais oeil cette amitié naissante: Quentin serait-il venu lui voler sa meilleure amie ?

programme.title: PREMIER TRIO

programme.title: COMPOSTMAN ET MOI

programme.title: BOUFFE D'AIR FRAIS
programme.desc: Anouck s'arrête cette fois-ci dans la région des Gastlosen. Elle y grimpe et présente, au pied d'une falaise et dans un paysage de carte postale, une recette simple pour un en-cas sportif équilibré qui permet de garder la forme toute la journée.

programme.title: DESTINATION FRANCOPHONIE
programme.desc: Suite du périple à Javouhey, étonnant village fondé par des réfugiés hmongs dans les années 1970. Détour par la ville colorée de Mana, puis Kourou, son mythique centre spatial et sa foisonnante biodiversité. Le voyage se termine au centre Kalawashi, engagé dans la transmission et la préservation des cultures autochtones.

programme.title: MAGHREB-ORIENT EXPRESS
programme.desc: Très remarquée pour sa pièce « Les Poupées persanes », récompensée par deux Molières, Aïda Asgharzadeh renoue avec le succès dans « Le Dernier Cèdre du Liban ». Actuellement au théâtre de l'oeuvre, à Paris ; au Festival d'Avignon, en juillet 2026. L'occasion pour elle de s'éloigner de l'Iran et de plonger dans les dernières années de la guerre civile libanaise.La dernière idée créative de Fouad Boussouf : faire se rencontrer un ballon et un violon. Son spectacle « °UP » transforme le plateau en terrain de jeu poétique. Mêler les genres, les rythmes, les univers, c'est ce qui anime le chorégraphe. Dans « YËS », il allie pratiques hip-hop contemporaines et traditionnelles. Ses créations tournent en France, au Royaume-Uni et bientôt au Cambodge.Avec « Bosphore Tango », Metin Arditi clôt sa « Trilogie de Constantinople » : une fresque sur un siècle qui dépeint les transformations de la Turquie, de la chute de l'Empire ottoman aux années Erdo?an. Du Bosphore aux lacs suisses, le lecteur suit plusieurs familles et leurs descendants, aux destins malmenés par l'histoire.Artiste autodidacte, Mohamed Saïd Chair peint et met en scène la jeunesse tangeroise, à la manière des grands maîtres du XVIe siècle. Entre Paris et Tanger, reportage de Maud Ninauve.

programme.desc: Epäonniset FBI-agentit Marcus ja Kevin saavat täpärästi pitää työpaikkansa. Kun seurapiirisiskokset loukkaantuvat agenttien valvovien silmän alla, on heidän ryhdyttävä elämänsä peiteoperaatioon.

programme.title: I Feel Pretty (12)

programme.title: Lumoava kirous (12)

Siksi Lenaa aletaan kiusata koulussa. Ainoa valopilkku on Ethan, poika joka tahtoo vain valmistua koulusta ja muuttaa pois. Perheiden varoituksista huolimatta nuoret rakastuvat, ja se muuttaa molempien elämän lopullisesti.

programme.title: Sing (0)
programme.desc: Buster Moon johtaa parhaat päivänsä nähnyttä teatteria. Buster on ikuinen optimisti, joka rakastaa teatteriaan yli kaiken ja on valmis tekemään mitä vain pelastaakseen sen.

programme.title: My Little Pony elokuva (0)
programme.desc: Equestrian taianomaisessa valtakunnassa nimeltä Canterlot elää poneja, joita hallitsee neljä prinsessaa. Ystävyyden juhlan alla valtakuntaa uhkaa Myrskykuninkaan apuri Tempest Shadow joukkoineen. Kaaoksen keskellä kuusi ponia onnistuu pakanemaan, ja prinsessa Twilight Sparkle päättää toteuttaa prinsessa Celestian suunnitelman hakea apua meriponien kuningattarelta. Kuusikko lähtee pelastamaan ystäviään ja oppii samalla, että ystävys on taikaa!

programme.title: Maracuda (7)
programme.desc: Maracuda, arvostetun heimojohtajan poika, kamppailee täyttääkseen isänsä odotukset. Hän lähtee salaperäiseen metsään todistamaan kykynsä ja tapaa siellä Tinkin – taianomaisen linnun ulkoavaruudesta. Yhdessä he seikkailevat uskomattomissa kivikautisissa metsissä, mutta seikkailun tiimellyksessä Tink muuttaa vahingossa Maracudan isän pikkuruiseksi olennoksi, ja pojan on opetettava Tinkiä hallitsemaan voimiaan. Unohtumattomat kokemukset opettavat Maracudaa kantamaan vastuuta, ja hänen isänsä puolestaan oppii ymmärtämään poikaansa.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda (7)
programme.desc: Po on nuudeleita maiskutteleva unelmoija, jonka täytyy hyväksyä itsensä vikoineen kaikkineen, jos hän mielii kehittyä legendaariseksi lohikäärmetaistelijaksi.

programme.title: Bamse ja tulivuorisaari (0)
programme.desc: Bamse, Pomppi ja Kilpinen suuntaavat Jules Vernen klassikkoseikkailun innoittamana maan keskipisteeseen, kun Kiljusen vanhan tutkijakollega katoaa mystisesti tutkimusmatkallaan.

programme.title: Lasse vs Lasse (7)
programme.desc: Kun Lasse aloittaa nelosella, hän järkyttyy. Hänen paikallaan istuu uusi poika, joka on kaikkea mitä Lasse haluaa olla. Ja hänenkin nimensä on Lasse!

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda 2 (7)

programme.desc: Kolme ystävystä, Niels, Thomas ja Andrew, lähtee henkeäsalpaavalle matkalle halki kesäisen Tanskan päästäkseen upeaan kastejuhlaan.

programme.desc: Maailmanlaajuiseen bestselleriin After perustuvassa toisessa elokuvassa seuraamme Tessan kiivasta eroa ja sen seurauksia. Voittaako rakkaus menneet?

programme.desc: (Yhdysvallat 2016) Jännityselokuva lukiolaistytöstä, joka sotkeentuu totuus vai tehtävä -tyyppiseen nettipeliin. Alun hauska jännitys alkaa pian muuttua uhkaavaksi, kun hän joutuu anonyymien katsojien ohjailemaksi.

programme.title: Masterminds (12)

programme.desc: Countrytähti Liam Page palaa kymmenen vuoden tauon jälkeen kotipaikkakunnalleen ja kohtaa taakseen jättämän rakkauden.

programme.title: Edge of Darkness (15)
programme.desc: Kun poliisi Thomas Cravenin 24-vuotias tytär murhataan hänen ovellaan, kaikki luulevat, että Craven oli tarkoitus murhata. Hitaasti, mutta varmasti Craven saa selville tyttärensä salaisuuksia.

programme.title: Seitsemän Psykopaattia (15)

Eräänä päivänä he varastavat sikäläisen rikollisjohtajan rakkaan pikku räksyttäjän ja saavat koko Los Angelesin alamaailman kimppuunsa.

programme.title: Punainen lohikäärme (15)

Löytääkseen murhaajan hänen on turvauduttava vankilassa olevan psykopaatti Hannibal Lecterin apuun - mutta voiko tähän todella luottaa? Anthony Hopkins on taas kerran Hannibal Lecter trillerissä, joka sijoittuu aikaan ennen Uhrilampaita.

programme.title: No Chains No Masters (15)
programme.desc: Vuonna 1759 Mauritius-saarella 16-vuotias Mati kieltäytyy elämästä orjana ranskalaisten hallitsemalla plantaasilla. Hän pakenee viidakkoon etsimään vapautta yhteisöstä, joka koostuu muista karanneista orjista.

programme.title: Z for Zachariah (12)
programme.desc: Ydinsodan jälkeisessä maailmassa elävä nuori nainen käy omaa selviytymistaisteluaan, uskoen, että hän saattaa todellakin olla viimeinen eloonjäänyt maan päällä. Hän ei kuitenkaan ole yksin, vaan kohtaa yllätyksekseen hämmentyneen tiedemiehen, joka on ajautunut lähes hulluuden partaalle säteilyn vaikutuksesta ja epätoivostaan löytää muita selviytyjiä. Heidän välilleen vähitellen syntyvä yhteys alkaa kuitenkin pian rakoilla, kun laaksoon saapuu salaperäinen muukalainen.

programme.title: Jurassic World: Dominion (12)
programme.desc: Neljä vuotta Isla Nublarin tuhon jälkeen dinosaurukset ovat elossa ja saalistavat ihmisten läheisyydessä ympäri maailman. Hauras kauhun tasapaino muovaa nyt tulevaisuutta ratkaisten lopullisesti pysyykö ihminen ravintoketjun huipulla joutuessaan jakamaan planeetan historian pelottavimpien petojen kanssa.

programme.title: Prisoner's Daughter (15)

programme.desc: Ria Khan uskoo, että hänen on pelastettava isosiskonsa Lena menemästä vääriin naimisiin. Suostuteltuaan ystävänsä avukseen hän lähtee toteuttamaan kaikkien aikojen morsiamenryöstöä itsenäisyyden ja sisaruuden nimessä.

Elokuva on yhden naisen tarina. Se kertoo seksistä, himosta, sisäisistä ajatuksista, salaisuuksista, avioliitosta, totuudesta, vallasta ja suostumuksesta – naisen näkökulmasta.

programme.desc: Paddington-karhu eksyy viidakkoon, kun hän aikoo vierailla Lucy-tädin luona. Brownin perhe seuraa mukana huikealla matkalla, kun mysteeri syöksee heidät yllättävälle pakomatkalle Amazonin sademetsiin ja aina Perun vuoristoon saakka.

programme.title: The Long Game (12)

Hänet torjutaan ihonvärin takia, joten hän tutustuu nuoriin latinomailapoikiin, jotka ovat rakentaneet oman golfkentän. Heillä on vähän kokemusta ja resursseja, mutta JB saa pojat perustamaan oman golfjoukkueen. Se vie heidät kaikki matkalle, jonka aikana he oppivat, että historian tekemiseen vaaditaan muutakin kuin golftaitoja.

programme.title: Not Without Hope (15)

Myrskyn lähestyessä pojat irrottavat juuttunutta ankkuria, kun vene kaatuu ja ja he sinkoutuvat hyiseen veteen. Yhdysvaltain rannikkovartioston kapteeni Timothy Close johtaa pelastusoperaatiota raivoavassa meressä, kun ystävykset kamppailevat valtavia aaltoja, nestehukkaa, vakavaa hypotermiaa – ja jopa haita vastaan pysyäkseen hengissä.

Sarah (Margot Robbie) ja David (Colin Farrell) ovat kaksi sinkkua, jotka tapaavat yhteisten ystäviensä häissä ja päätyvät pian vaikuttavallematkalle. Hauskalla ja fantastisella seikkailulla kumpikin heistä saa elää uudestaan menneisyytensä tärkeitä hetkiä ja kenties muuttaa tulevaisuuttaan.

Heidän ollessa syrjäisessä kartanossa sieppaajien määrä alkaa vähentyä yksitellen, ja he huomaavat kauhukseen lukittautuneensa sisälle epänormaalin pikkutytön kanssa.

programme.desc: CIA-agentti (Chris Pine) saa tehtäväkseen selvittää terroriteon tapahtumia ja etsii käsiinsä entisen kollegansa ja rakastettunsa (Thandiwe Newton).

programme.desc: Bad Genius on vauhdikas trilleri, jonka pääosissa nähdään Benedict Wong, Callina Liang ja Jabari Banks. Elokuvassa seurataan Lynniä, joka voittaa täyden stipendin arvostettuun high schooliin, jossa hän auttaa uusien ystäviensä kanssa muita oppilaita pärjäämään tenteissään.

programme.title: Erämaan vartijat
programme.desc: Tänään Vegarin tehtävänä on löytää tutkijoille ilves, jolle laitetaan lähetin. Kollega Terje on saanut kutsumattomia vieraita, savupiippuun on juuttunut kaksi lehtopöllöä.

programme.title: Grönlannin ja Tanskan yhteinen historia
programme.desc: Pappi Hans Egede halusi vimmatusti matkustaa Grönlantiin lähetyssaarnaajaksi, ja vuonna 1721 hän lopulta lähti vaaralliselle matkalle Atlantin yli. Grönlannin asukkaat, inuitit, eivät kuitenkaan toivottaneet häntä tervetulleeksi, sillä heillä oli jo oma uskontonsa. Syntyi dramaattinen yhteentörmäys kahden kulttuurin erilaisen elämäntavan ja maailmankatsomuksen välillä.

programme.title: Antiikkimakasiini
programme.desc: Saamelainen taide on viime vuosina saanut näkyvyyttä museoissa ja gallerioissa kautta maailman. Kaksi merkittävää saamelaistaiteen puolestapuhujaa saapuu keskustelemaan perinteistä, mytologiasta ja aktivismista. Vieraina taiteilijat Britta Marakatt-Labba ja Carola Grahn.

programme.title: Pohjoismainen design, rakkaustarina
programme.desc: Vuodet 1960-79. Muotoilijat haluavat muuttaa koko elämäntyylimme. Ja USA:ssa presidentin puoliso Jackie Kennedy alkaa käyttää Marimekon puuvillamekkoja ja Björn Weckströmin kaulakoru pääsee Star Wars -elokuvaan. Aikakauden edustavin hahmo oli kuitenkin futuristisesta tyylistään tunnettu tanskalainen designeri Verner Panton. Tässä jaksossa belgialainen keräilijä Kenneth Ramaekers avaa kotinsa ja kertoo, miten Panton on muuttanut hänen elämänsä.

programme.title: Kuvapläjäys
programme.desc: Miten saat videostasi hirveän, pelottavan tai hauskan? Mikä on elokuvan kuvakäsikirjoitus, ja mitä elokuvassa tarkoittaa käännekohta? Bruno ja elokuvaleikkaaja Johan tekevät sekä kolkon että koomisen videon.

programme.title: Team Bachstad Afrikassa
programme.desc: Saksalaisessa Swakopmundissa sijaitsee Namibian pienin museo, joka tarjoaa matkan pysäyttävimmän tarinan. Øystein löytää tuhatvuotiaan ja ehkä sarvikuononkin.

programme.title: Efter Nion parhaat
programme.desc: Christoffer Strandberg perusti puutarhan ja nyt hän vihaa jäniksiä ja peuroja, mutta rakastaa susia.

programme.title: Jazzia Norjan radion sinfoniaorkesterin kanssa
programme.desc: Jazzkitaristi Hans Mathisen esittää tähtimuusikoista koostuvan kollegajoukon ja KORKin kanssa uuden jazzsolisteille ja orkesterille sävelletyn teoksen Directions.

programme.title: Klaus Mäkelä, kohti liekkiä
programme.desc: Legendaarinen dokumentaristi Bruno Monsaingeon löysi nuoren Klaus Mäkelän vuonna 2021 Orchestre de Paris'n konsertissa. Nyt Mäkelä kertoo Monsaingeonille musiikin tulkinnasta ja pikkutarkasta lähestymisestä konsertteihin sekä oman henkilöhistoriansa ja oppivuotensa Jorma Panulan tunnetulla kapellimestariluokalla. (Towards The Flame, Ranska 2023)

programme.title: Sodankylän parhaat
programme.desc: Sodankylässä 2016 vierailleen skottituotannon pioneerin Bill Forsythin elokuva on mainio, ympäristökysymyksiäkin edellä aikaansa kosketteleva komedia. Teksasilaisen suuryhtiön kaksi kellokasta saapuu ostamaan kaunista merenrantakylää öljynjalostamoa varten. Konkaritähti Burt Lancasterin tulkitsema inhimillinen pomo ratkoo dollarimiljoonien houkutuksia.

programme.title: La Promesa - Salaisuuksien kartano (12)
programme.desc: Lorenzon tykitys Ángelan - ja Curron - elämän pilaamiseksi jatkuu täysillä, järkipuhe ei pure mieheen. Enora sairastuu yllättäen, ja Toño yrittää olla avuksi. Mikähän Samuelia vaivaa?

programme.title: Merirosvohiiri Polly (S)
programme.desc: Merirosvot suuntaavat hyytävän kylmälle etsintäretkelle ja löytävät heti kauniita aarteita. Miehistö on kuitenkin pettynyt Pollyn suoritukseen kapteenina, ja siksi hänen onkin todistettava, että hän on tittelinsä arvoinen.

programme.title: Kallen keittiö (S)
programme.desc: Esa haluaa yllättää Jennin kukkakimpulla. Maiskulan väki auttaa Esaa yhteisvoimin kukkakimpun piilottelussa, mutta eräs nälkäinen vuohi osoittautuu heitä ovelammaksi.

programme.title: Yle Nyheter TV-nytt 19.30
programme.desc: Viimeisimmät uutiset, uutisanalyysit ja reportaasit ruotsinkieliseltä rannikkoseudulta, muualta Suomesta ja maailmalta.

programme.title: Jospa tietäisit (12)
programme.desc: Kuvaus Ruotsissa asuvasta nuorukaisesta, joka valmistautuu suorittamaan asevelvollisuutensa Suomessa. Yrittäessään epätoivoisesti paeta sekä kansalaisvelvollisuuttaan että tukahdutettua lapsuuttaankin nuorelle miehelle ei jää muuta vaihtoehtoa kuin kohdata todelliset tunteensa. Pääosaa esittää elokuvan käsikirjoittaja Filip Slotte. Tuotanto: Keep Films 2023.

programme.title: Aika ennen meitä (12)
programme.desc: Vuodet vierivät ja poikien on aika astua työelämään. Unelma elokuvateatterin perustamisesta yhdistää ja ajaa eteenpäin. Juuri kun unelmasta tulee totta, kohtalon koura iskee koko perheeseen.

programme.title: Frida Kahlon elämä ja kohtalo
programme.desc: Elämäkerturi Martha Zamora kertoo Fridan koulukapinasta, ihastumisista poikiin ja Diego Riveran tapaamisesta. Kuulu taitelija mullisti Fridan elämän. Onnettomuus vuonna 1925 nujersi Fridan haaveet lääkärinurasta ja edessä oli vamman sanelema elämä. Frida kanavoi tuskansa ryhtymällä taitelijaksi.

programme.title: Fabulous Cow Ladies
programme.desc: Dokumentti kolmesta naisesta ja heidän omistamistaan kolmesta lehmästä, jotka elävät metsälaitumella, ympäri vuoden ulkona. Talven tullen lehmiä hoivaavia naisia kohtaa suru, mutta kevään myötä luonnon kiertokulku saa jatkua. O: Mia Halme. T: Sahadok, Suomi 2024)

programme.title: Kesäkonsertti Schönbrunnista 2026
programme.desc: Wienin filharmonikkojen perinteinen kesäkonsertti Schönbrunnin linnan pihalta. Tapahtuman kapellimestarina on ensi kertaa Lorenzo Viotti, ja solistina on bassobaritoni Sir Bryn Terfel. Konsertissa kuullaan aarioita mm. Verdin Falstaffista, Wagnerin Reininkullasta sekä laulu Viulunsoittaja katolla -musikaalista. Konsertin selostaa Lauri Itäkannas.

programme.title: BUU-klubben
programme.desc: Kun BUU-klubbenin tapahtumat on päivitetty, katsomme BUU-klubbenin 9. kaudelta jakson Kuinka saada kasvi kuriin? ja BUU-kinossa esitetään sarjoja Kuviomaa ja Näätäset.

programme.title: BUU-klubben (7)
programme.desc: Mitähän BUU-klubbenissa tapahtuu tänään? Sen selvittyä katsomme BUU-klubbenin 9. kaudelta jakson Tanssin aika! ja BUU-kinossa katsotaan sarjoja Pikkuli, Cowboyhamsteri Billy ja Possuli.

programme.title: Muumit Rivieralla, ruotsinkielinen versio (S)
programme.desc: Merellisen seikkailun jälkeen Muumit löytävät itsensä Rivieran suihkuseurapiirien keskeltä. Tove Janssonin alkuperäiset sarjakuvat heräävät henkiin animaatioelokuvassa. O: Xavier Picard. (Suomi-Ranska 2014)

programme.title: Tuntematon perillinen
programme.desc: Italialaisveljekset Aldo ja Dante Casnici saapuivat Ruotsiin töihin vuonna 1948. Kattis Ahlström ja Niklas Källner yrittävät selvittää kuka heidät perii. Jaksossa seurataan myös tapausta vuodelta 2018.

programme.title: Unelmapuutarha
programme.desc: Jakob aikoo tehdä pihapiirin vanhasta tallista orangerian eli talvipuutarhan - vai onko se sittenkin kasvihuone? Rakennusprojekti on samalla hänen hienopuusepänopintojensa lopputyö. Jokainen yksityiskohta nikkaroidaan käsin, niin että lopputuloksena syntyy upea paikka, jossa kelpaa viljellä ja rentoutua. Linnéa Dickson ja Nicole Wilson vierailevat ruotsalaisten luona ja antavat vinkkejä unelmapuutarhan toteuttamiseen.

programme.title: La Promesa - Salaisuuksien kartano (12)
programme.desc: María ei saa suuta auki Carlon edessä, Petra puolestaan selvittää reseptivarkauden. Alonso vetoaa Leocadiaan vielä kerran. Manuel tivaa selitystä, mihin Enora ja Toño ovat aikansa käyttäneet.

programme.title: La Promesa - Salaisuuksien kartano (12)
programme.desc: Kuinka Manuelin suoriutuu riskaabelista testilennosta? Tunnelma kartanossa vain tihenee, sillä Lorenzon ja Ángelan vihkiäisiin on en enää vähän aikaa. Jacobo on tylyllä tuulella.

programme.title: La Promesa - Salaisuuksien kartano (12)
programme.desc: Saako Santos kerrankin maksaa tekosistaan? Pía kantaa huolta Ángelan jaksamisesta. Leocadian järjestämä yksityisetsivä palaa yllättäen asiaan, mikä ei ole kaikille mieleen.

programme.title: La Promesa - Salaisuuksien kartano (12)
programme.desc: Manuelin lentokonetiimi toimii taas loistavasti yhteen. Teresan määräykset kovenevat. Manuel heittää Lorenzolle houkuttelevan täkyn, mutta saako se sulhasmiehen mielen muuttumaan?

programme.title: La Promesa - Salaisuuksien kartano (12)
programme.desc: Lorenzon tykitys Ángelan - ja Curron - elämän pilaamiseksi jatkuu täysillä, järkipuhe ei pure mieheen. Enora sairastuu yllättäen, ja Toño yrittää olla avuksi. Mikähän Samuelia vaivaa?

programme.title: Eläinten päiväkoti (S) (S)
programme.desc: Pikkolo on pienin ja tuntee itsensä erilaiseksi. Vaan ehkä onkin niin, että kaikki ovat erilaisia omalla tavallaan. Ja kun kakku katoaa, on oikein hyvä, että Pikkolo on juuri sellainen kuin hän on.

programme.title: Leikkien keräilijät (S)
programme.desc: Leikkien keräilijät huomaavat päätyneensä ihmeelliselle planeetalle, missä on vaaleanpunaisia kraattereita ja pilvenhattaroita. Juuri kun uuden hauskan leikin pitäisi alkaa, Nina kuitenkin katoaa.

programme.title: Dino Dex (7)
programme.desc: Kun Kajsan pikkusisko ei saa unta, koska talossa on dinosaurus, Dexin ja Kajsan on syytä tutkia yösaalistamisen mestaria shuvuuiaa.

programme.title: Carmen-kiharat (12)
programme.desc: Lehdistö on kuullut Carmenin myynnistä, joten Axelin on kiiruhdettava New Yorkiin. Birthe, Frans ja Kaj syyttelevät toisiaan tiedon vuotamisesta.

programme.title: Tarinoita metsästä: Kallioiden asukkaita
programme.desc: Ilves, kyy, vaskitsa, sisilisko. Kallioiden asukkaita.

programme.title: Sportnytt
programme.desc: Urheilu-uutisia.

programme.title: Livet - suomenruotsalaisia tarinoita
programme.desc: Lapsena loviisalainen Petra Nyqvist näki vanhempiensa rehkivän ja uurastavan, jotta maatila saataisiin kannattamaan. Hän ei halunnut tulla heidän kaltaisekseen. Lasten saamisen myötä ilmastoahdistus kuitenkin sai hänestä otteen. Mitä hän voisi osaltaan tehdä paremman maailman eteen?

programme.title: Diskon aikakausi

Kolmessa lyhytvideossa kuljetaan matka Tanssin talolle. Tanssija ja koreografi Tuomo Railo on edustanut tanssijoita välillä yksin edistäessään hanketta virkamiesten ja poliitikkojen pöydissä.
